api.auth_middleware.present.description: Public API routes MUST require authentication middleware.

api.openapi.published.description: Externally consumed APIs MUST publish an OpenAPI document.

api.rate_limit.enabled.description: Public APIs MUST enforce rate limiting.

cicd.branch_protection.required_reviews.description: Default branch protection MUST require at least one review.

identity.mfa.required.description: Administrative interactive login MUST require MFA.

identity.password.min_length.description: Password minimum length MUST be at least 12 characters.

identity.refresh_token.rotation_enabled.description: Refresh tokens MUST use rotation on use.

kubernetes.deployment.replicas.description: Production deployments MUST run at least three replicas.

kubernetes.liveness_probe.present.description: Long-running services MUST define a liveness probe.

kubernetes.network_policy.present.description: Namespaced production workloads MUST have a default-deny NetworkPolicy baseline.

kubernetes.pod_disruption_budget.min_ava.description: PDBs for tier-1 services MUST keep at least two pods available.

kubernetes.pod_disruption_budget.present.description: Disruption-sensitive workloads MUST have a matching PodDisruptionBudget.

kubernetes.readiness_probe.present.description: HTTP services MUST define a readiness probe.

messaging.dlq.present.description: Durable consumers MUST configure a dead-letter queue.

observability.logging.pii_scrubbing.description: Log pipelines MUST scrub known PII fields.

observability.logging.structured_json.description: Services MUST emit structured JSON logs.

security.encryption_at_rest.enabled.description: Datastores holding customer data MUST enable encryption at rest.

security.hsts.enabled.description: Public HTTPS services MUST send HSTS.

security.tls_policy.id.description: Edge TLS MUST use an approved policy identifier.

session.idle_timeout_seconds.description: Idle session timeout MUST NOT exceed 300 seconds.

session.ttl_seconds.description: Authenticated session lifetime MUST NOT exceed 600 seconds.
